items.title: Why the Garden Schedule Changed
items.topic: a community garden adjusting its watering schedule after comparing soil conditions
items.benefit: a regular schedule made responsibilities clear and prevented plants from being forgotten
items.challenge: fixed watering days sometimes gave plants too much water after rain and too little during dry periods
items.lesson: routines are useful starting points, but observations should guide adjustments when conditions change
items.topicJa: 土の状態を比べて水やり予定を見直す地域菜園
items.benefitJa: 定期的な予定で担当が明確になり植物の世話忘れを防げること
items.challengeJa: 固定した水やり日は雨の後には多すぎ乾燥時には足りない場合があること
items.lessonJa: 習慣は出発点として役立つが状況が変われば観察に基づいて調整する必要がある

items.title: The Bus Stop Survey
items.topic: students surveying bus stop users before proposing a new shelter
items.benefit: short surveys helped the group learn when the stop was busiest and what problems users noticed
items.challenge: people who used the stop at unusual times were underrepresented in the first survey
items.lesson: collecting information at several times can produce a more balanced picture of public needs
items.topicJa: 新しい屋根を提案する前にバス停利用者を調査する生徒たち
items.benefitJa: 短い調査で混雑時間や利用者が感じる問題を知ることができること
items.challengeJa: 通常と違う時間に利用する人が最初の調査では十分に含まれなかったこと
items.lessonJa: 複数の時間帯で情報を集めると公共の需要をより偏りなく把握できる

items.title: Repair Before Replace
items.topic: a school technology club testing whether broken classroom devices could be repaired before replacement
items.benefit: simple repairs reduced waste and saved money that could be used for other equipment
items.challenge: some devices looked similar but required different parts and repair methods
items.lesson: repair programs need careful diagnosis rather than assuming one solution fits every failure
items.topicJa: 壊れた教室機器を買い替える前に修理できるか試す技術部
items.benefitJa: 簡単な修理でごみと費用を減らし他の設備に予算を使えること
items.challengeJa: 似た機器でも必要な部品や修理方法が異なる場合があること
items.lessonJa: 修理ではすべてに同じ方法を当てはめず故障原因を丁寧に調べる必要がある

items.title: A Different Kind of School Notice
items.topic: a student council comparing paper notices with digital messages for school announcements
items.benefit: digital messages reached many families quickly and could be updated when details changed
items.challenge: not every family checked the same app regularly and important messages could be missed
items.lesson: communication is more reliable when important information is available through more than one practical channel
items.topicJa: 学校のお知らせで紙とデジタル通知を比較する生徒会
items.benefitJa: デジタルなら多くの家庭へ早く届け変更もすぐ反映できること
items.challengeJa: すべての家庭が同じアプリを頻繁に確認するとは限らず重要情報を見逃す可能性があること
items.lessonJa: 重要な情報は実用的な複数の手段で届けるとより確実になる
